content.title: About
content.content: Baby Toddler Carrots, Stage 2 are gently cooked carrot pieces designed for children aged 12 to 24 months. The product is steam‑cooked to retain most of the vitamins and minerals while becoming soft enough for tiny teeth to handle safely.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Carrots are one of the first vegetables introduced to infants because of their natural sweetness.
Stage 2 offers larger pieces than Stage 1, helping develop chewing skills.
Beta‑carotene in carrots converts to vitamin A, essential for vision and immunity.
Most carrots are grown without synthetic pesticides in major producing countries, making them safe for babies.
Steam cooking preserves up to 90 % of vitamin C.

items.title: Rich in beta‑carotene
items.content: Beta‑carotene is converted to vitamin A, supporting eye health, growth, and immune function.

items.title: Supports digestion
items.content: The fiber in carrots promotes regular bowel movements and helps prevent constipation.

items.title: Antioxidant properties
items.content: Vitamin C and carotenoids protect cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: Minerals for growth
items.content: Carrots provide potassium, important for fluid balance and muscle function.

items.title: Low allergen risk
items.content: Carrots rarely cause allergic reactions, making them a safe choice for most infants.

items.title: Choking hazard
items.content: Although the pieces are soft, they should be offered under adult supervision, especially to children just beginning to chew.

items.title: Vitamin loss with overcooking
items.content: Excessive heat can reduce vitamin C content.

items.title: Possible pesticide residues
items.content: Look for organic certification if you want to minimize any pesticide exposure.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve the carrots warm or at room temperature. They can be mixed with a small amount of apple or potato puree for flavor variety. For children who can chew, the pieces can be lightly mashed with a fork.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the package in a dry, cool place away from direct sunlight. After opening, transfer to an airtight container and use within 7 days. Discard if you notice off‑odors or discoloration.
